```yaml
name: Close Old Bot Discussions

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'  # Runs daily at midnight UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  close-old-bot-discussions:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Close stale bot discussions
        uses: actions/stale@v10
        with:
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          stale-issue-message: |
            This issue has been automatically marked as stale because it has not had any activity for 30 days.
          stale-issue-label: bot-discussion
          days-before-stale: 30
          days-before-close: 7
          close-issue-message: |
            This issue has been automatically closed because it has not had any activity for 7 days after being marked as stale.
          close-issue-label: bot-discussion-closed
```
